meaning.en: A spoiled child of a wealthy family who lives idly and extravagantly.
meaning.zh: 指富贵人家不务正业、只知享乐的子弟。

examples.zh: 他是个纨绔子弟，整天飙车泡吧。
examples.en: He's a spoiled rich kid who spends his days racing cars and clubbing.

examples.zh: 别把他当纨绔子弟，他其实很努力。
examples.en: Don't take him for an idle rich kid; he actually works hard.

examples.zh: 小说里的纨绔子弟败光了家产。
examples.en: The playboy in the novel squandered the family fortune.

meaning.en: Equal in ability; no telling which is better.
meaning.zh: 分不出高下，水平相当。

examples.zh: 两位选手的实力不分伯仲。
examples.en: The two players are evenly matched.

examples.zh: 这两部电影的票房不分伯仲。
examples.en: The two films did equally well at the box office.

examples.zh: 两人的书法不分伯仲。
examples.en: Their calligraphy is on a par.

story.en: Cao Pi on Ban Gu and Fu Yi: 'Fu Yi and Ban Gu are almost equal' (傅毅之于班固，伯仲之间耳).
story.zh: 曹丕《典论·论文》：“傅毅之于班固，伯仲之间耳。”

natural: a modest, pretty girl from an ordinary family

meaning.en: A young woman of ordinary family, pretty and gentle.
meaning.zh: 指出身普通人家、容貌清秀的年轻女子。

equivalents: a modest and delicate young woman

examples.zh: 她是个小家碧玉，温柔贤淑。
examples.en: She is a gentle, pretty girl from an ordinary family.

examples.zh: 相比大家闺秀，我更喜欢小家碧玉的清新。
examples.en: Compared with the grand lady, I like the freshness of the girl-next-door.

examples.zh: 这位小家碧玉嫁入了豪门。
examples.en: This modest beauty married into a wealthy family.

usage.en: Noun, often paired with 大家闺秀.
usage.zh: 作名词，常与“大家闺秀”对举。

meaning.en: Originally the foreign concessions in old Shanghai; now any glittering, bustling metropolis.
meaning.zh: 旧时指上海租界，后泛指繁华而带有洋气的大都市。

examples.zh: 老上海的十里洋场，灯红酒绿。
examples.en: Old Shanghai's foreign quarter was a world of neon and wine.

examples.zh: 他初来十里洋场，眼花缭乱。
examples.en: Newly arrived in the glittering city, he was dazzled.

examples.zh: 这部电影重现了十里洋场的风情。
examples.en: The film recreates the glamour of old Shanghai.

usage.zh: 作名词，让人联想到民国时期的上海。

meaning.en: Utterly loyal and devoted.
meaning.zh: 形容非常忠诚。

examples.zh: 他对祖国赤胆忠心。
examples.en: He is wholeheartedly loyal to his country.

examples.zh: 老管家对主人赤胆忠心。
examples.en: The old steward is utterly devoted to his master.

examples.zh: 这是一位赤胆忠心的战士。
examples.en: This is a soldier of unwavering loyalty.

synonyms: 孙悟空保唐僧——忠心耿耿

meaning.en: Smooth progress in one's official career.
meaning.zh: 做官的运气好，仕途顺利。

examples.zh: 祝你官运亨通，步步高升！
examples.en: May your career go smoothly and rise step by step!

examples.zh: 他官运亨通，三年连升三级。
examples.en: His career has gone smoothly, with three promotions in three years.

examples.zh: 官运亨通的人未必真有才干。
examples.en: Those with smooth careers don't necessarily have real talent.

meaning.en: To understand people's abilities and put them in suitable roles.
meaning.zh: 了解人的才能，善于安排合适的职务。

equivalents: put the right people in the right jobs

examples.zh: 好的领导要知人善任。
examples.en: A good leader knows how to put people in the right posts.

examples.zh: 刘邦知人善任，终成大业。
examples.en: Liu Bang was a shrewd judge of talent and so achieved great things.

examples.zh: 公司老板知人善任，团队很有活力。
examples.en: The boss assigns people well, so the team is full of energy.

natural: hold one's nose and pass by

meaning.en: To cover one's nose and walk past in disgust.
meaning.zh: 捂着鼻子走过去，形容厌恶。

equivalents: hold one's nose and walk past

examples.zh: 垃圾堆发出臭味，行人掩鼻而过。
examples.en: The rubbish heap stank, and passers-by held their noses.

examples.zh: 这种低俗的节目，观众只会掩鼻而过。
examples.en: Viewers would only turn away from such vulgar programmes.

examples.zh: 他对这类事嗤之以鼻，掩鼻而过。
examples.en: He sneers at such things and walks past in disgust.

story.en: Mencius: 'Even Xishi, if covered in filth, would be passed by with everyone covering their noses' (西子蒙不洁，则人皆掩鼻而过之).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“西子蒙不洁，则人皆掩鼻而过之。”

meaning.en: To bow and bend the knee in servile flattery.
meaning.zh: 弯腰屈膝，形容没有骨气地奉承讨好。

examples.zh: 他对上司卑躬屈膝，毫无尊严。
examples.en: He grovels to his boss and has no dignity.

examples.zh: 我们不能向强权卑躬屈膝。
examples.en: We must not bow and scrape to power.

examples.zh: 她从不卑躬屈膝地求人。
examples.en: She never begs others servilely.

antonyms: 富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈

meaning.en: To value good faith and promote harmony (among people or states).
meaning.zh: 讲求信用，培养和睦的关系。

examples.zh: 两国应讲信修睦，和平共处。
examples.en: The two countries should keep faith and live in peace.

examples.zh: 邻里之间讲信修睦，社区才和谐。
examples.en: A community is harmonious when neighbours keep faith and get along.

examples.zh: 外交政策强调讲信修睦。
examples.en: The foreign policy stresses good faith and harmony.

story.en: Liji, describing the age of Great Harmony: 'Choosing the worthy and able, stressing good faith and cultivating harmony' (选贤与能，讲信修睦).
story.zh: 《礼记·礼运》：“大道之行也，天下为公，选贤与能，讲信修睦。”

usage.zh: 多作谓语，多用于外交场合。

meaning.en: Continuing without a break.
meaning.zh: 连续不断。

examples.zh: 山路上车流绵绵不绝。
examples.en: Traffic on the mountain road flowed on unbroken.

examples.zh: 春雨绵绵不绝，下了一整个星期。
examples.en: The spring rain fell continuously for a whole week.

examples.zh: 他们的友谊绵绵不绝。
examples.en: Their friendship continues unbroken.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial. Close in meaning to 绵延不绝 and 连绵不断.

literal: left · prop up · right · fall short

meaning.en: To be short of resources and unable to cope on every side.
meaning.zh: 这边支撑，那边又不足，形容力量、财力不够，难以应付。

examples.zh: 经费不足，工作左支右绌。
examples.en: With little funding, the work is stretched thin.

examples.zh: 一个人带三个孩子，左支右绌。
examples.en: With three children alone, she can't cope on every side.

examples.zh: 公司资金链紧张，左支右绌。
examples.en: The firm's cash flow is tight and it can't meet every need.

natural: use someone's own method on them

meaning.en: To turn the tables by applying the very method someone devised against them.
meaning.zh: 比喻用对方整治别人的办法来整治他。

equivalents: hoist someone with his own petard

examples.zh: 警方模仿骗子的手法设下圈套，请君入瓮，抓住了他。
examples.en: The police copied the swindler's own methods to set a trap, turning the tables on him and catching him.

examples.zh: 你用的这招，我正好拿来请君入瓮。
examples.en: I'll use the very trick you used and turn it on you.

examples.zh: 这是个请君入瓮的计谋。
examples.en: This is a plot to trap him with his own methods.

story.en: In the Tang, Lai Junchen invented torture methods; Empress Wu ordered Zhou Xinghao to interrogate him. Zhou said: 'Please enter this urn', and Lai confessed.
story.zh: 武则天命周兴审讯来俊臣，来俊臣说：“请君入此瓮。”周兴吓得认罪。

natural: keep an eye on all sides

meaning.en: To be alert and watch everything around; often used with 耳听八方.
meaning.zh: 眼睛注意各个方面，形容机敏。

equivalents: keep eyes peeled in all directions
be alert and aware of everything

examples.zh: 好司机要眼观六路，耳听八方。
examples.en: A good driver keeps eyes peeled and ears open all around.

examples.zh: 场上的中场队员要眼观六路。
examples.en: A midfielder must watch all around on the pitch.

examples.zh: 做生意要眼观六路，随时抓住机会。
examples.en: In business keep an eye on everything and seize chances.

usage.en: Usually 眼观六路，耳听八方.
usage.zh: 常说“眼观六路，耳听八方”。

meaning.en: To promote what is beneficial and remove what is harmful.
meaning.zh: 兴办有利的事，革除有害的事。

equivalents: promote the good and root out the bad

examples.zh: 新政府决心兴利除弊，整顿吏治。
examples.en: The new government resolved to promote benefits and remove ills.

examples.zh: 改革的目的是兴利除弊。
examples.en: The aim of reform is to promote benefit and remove harm.

examples.zh: 县令上任后兴利除弊，百姓称颂。
examples.en: After taking office the magistrate reformed things, and the people praised him.

literal: contain · feeling · gazing tenderly · gazing tenderly

meaning.en: Full of tender feeling, especially in one's look.
meaning.zh: 饱含深情，默默地表达爱意。

examples.zh: 她含情脉脉地望着他。
examples.en: She gazed at him tenderly.

examples.zh: 两人含情脉脉，不需要多说什么。
examples.en: The two exchanged loving looks and needed to say nothing.

examples.zh: 电影里含情脉脉的眼神打动了观众。
examples.en: The tender looks in the film moved the audience.

meaning.en: To feel disappointed and lost, as if something has gone.
meaning.zh: 因失望或失落而心里空荡荡的。

equivalents: feel a vague sense of loss

examples.zh: 毕业典礼之后，他怅然若失。
examples.en: After graduation he felt a sense of loss.

examples.zh: 送走客人，她怅然若失地站在门口。
examples.en: After seeing off the guests, she stood at the door feeling empty.

examples.zh: 读完小说的结尾，我怅然若失。
examples.en: Having finished the novel's ending, I was left bereft.

meaning.en: Extremely anxious, as if the heart were on fire.
meaning.zh: 忧虑焦急得像火烧一样。

examples.zh: 孩子高烧不退，父母忧心如焚。
examples.en: The child's fever would not break, and the parents were frantic with worry.

examples.zh: 听说灾情严重，他忧心如焚。
examples.en: Hearing the disaster was severe, he was burning with worry.

examples.zh: 看着病重的老人，家人忧心如焚。
examples.en: Watching the gravely ill old man, the family were sick with worry.

meaning.en: Of objects: delicately made and translucent; of people: clever and quick-witted.
meaning.zh: 形容器物精致、透明；也形容人聪明灵巧。

examples.zh: 这件玉雕玲珑剔透，美不胜收。
examples.en: This jade carving is delicate and translucent, beautiful beyond words.

examples.zh: 她心思玲珑剔透，一点就通。
examples.en: She's quick-witted and grasps things in a hint.

examples.zh: 水晶杯玲珑剔透，在灯下闪着光。
examples.en: The crystal glass is exquisite and sparkles under the lamp.

meaning.en: To be infatuated or so absorbed that one loses composure.
meaning.zh: 形容对人或事物迷恋、倾倒，失去常态。

examples.zh: 他被那位歌手迷得神魂颠倒。
examples.en: He is head over heels for that singer.

examples.zh: 她被美食弄得神魂颠倒。
examples.en: She was enraptured by the food.

examples.zh: 见到偶像，粉丝们个个神魂颠倒。
examples.en: On seeing their idol, the fans were all swept away.

usage.en: Predicate or complement 被……弄得神魂颠倒.

literal: find sweet · it · like · malt sugar

meaning.en: To accept hardship gladly, as if it were sweet.
meaning.zh: 面对艰难痛苦，心甘情愿，觉得像糖一样甜。

examples.zh: 为了理想，再苦再累他也甘之如饴。
examples.en: For his ideal he gladly endures any hardship.

examples.zh: 她对照顾病人甘之如饴。
examples.en: She takes care of the sick gladly.

examples.zh: 只要能和你在一起，吃苦也甘之如饴。
examples.en: As long as I'm with you, hardship tastes sweet.

usage.en: Predicate; often 甘之如饴 after 吃苦/受累.
